newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico crude ports say expect to reopen Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Mexico crude ports say expect to reopen Wednesday.

text.p: Two Mexican crude ports are expected to reopen on Wednesday after storms in the region kept the terminals shut for five consecutive days, officials said late Tuesday.

Winds at Dos Bocas and Pajaritos ports had relaxed to between 35 kmh and 40 kmh, down from up to 50 kmh, the officials said. Wave heights were still dangerous and could keep the ports shut until late in the day.
"We will check for a possible opening tomorrow, but I don't think it will be until midday or in the afternoon," Dos Bocas port captain Andres Torres told Reuters.
